schema.text: How does the quality of signs and wayfinding on your cycling route affect your journey?

options.text: Not at all — I can navigate easily regardless of signage quality
Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm my route
Significantly — unclear or missing signs sometimes disrupt my journey
Very significantly — poor signage makes navigation difficult without GPS or phone apps

en.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: How does the quality of signs and wayfinding on your cycling route affect your journey?
en.#Not at all — I can navigate easily rega: Not at all — I can navigate easily regardless of signage quality
en.#Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm: Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm my route
en.#Significantly — unclear or missing sign: Significantly — unclear or missing signs sometimes disrupt my journey
en.#Very significantly — poor signage makes: Very significantly — poor signage makes navigation difficult without GPS or phone apps

it.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: In che modo la qualità della segnaletica e delle indicazioni di orientamento lungo il percorso ciclabile influisce sul tuo viaggio?
it.#Not at all — I can navigate easily rega: Per niente — riesco a orientarmi facilmente indipendentemente dalla qualità della segnaletica
it.#Slightly — signs are occasionally helpf: Poco — la segnaletica è utile solo occasionalmente
it.#Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm: Moderatamente — mi affido alla segnaletica per confermare il percorso
it.#Significantly — unclear or missing sign: Molto — indicazioni poco chiare o mancanti a volte rendono più difficile il mio viaggio
it.#Very significantly — poor signage makes: Moltissimo — una segnaletica insufficiente rende difficile orientarsi senza GPS o applicazioni sul telefono

fr.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: Quel effet la qualité des panneaux et des indications d’orientation sur votre itinéraire à vélo a-t-elle sur votre trajet ?
fr.#Not at all — I can navigate easily rega: Aucun — je peux facilement m’orienter même si la signalisation est mauvaise
fr.#Slightly — signs are occasionally helpf: Faible — les panneaux sont parfois utiles
fr.#Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm: Modéré — j’utilise les panneaux pour vérifier mon itinéraire
fr.#Significantly — unclear or missing sign: Important — des panneaux peu clairs ou absents perturbent parfois mon trajet
fr.#Very significantly — poor signage makes: Très important — une mauvaise signalisation rend l’orientation difficile sans GPS ou application sur téléphone

de.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: Wie beeinflussen Qualität und Verständlichkeit von Schildern und Wegweisung auf Ihrer Radstrecke Ihre Fahrt?
de.#Not at all — I can navigate easily rega: Gar nicht — ich finde meinen Weg auch bei schlechter Beschilderung problemlos
de.#Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm: Mäßig — ich nutze Schilder, um meine Route zu bestätigen
de.#Significantly — unclear or missing sign: Stark — unklare oder fehlende Schilder stören manchmal meine Fahrt
de.#Very significantly — poor signage makes: Sehr stark — schlechte Beschilderung macht die Orientierung ohne GPS oder Handy-App schwierig

tr.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: Bisiklet güzergâhınızdaki tabela ve yönlendirmelerin kalitesi yolculuğunuzu nasıl etkiler?
tr.#Not at all — I can navigate easily rega: Hiç etkilemez — tabela kalitesi nasıl olursa olsun yönümü kolayca bulurum
tr.#Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm: Orta düzeyde — güzergâhımı doğrulamak için tabelalara güvenirim
tr.#Significantly — unclear or missing sign: Çok — belirsiz veya eksik tabelalar bazen yolculuğumu zorlaştırır
tr.#Very significantly — poor signage makes: Çok fazla — kötü yönlendirme GPS veya telefon uygulaması olmadan yön bulmayı zorlaştırır

fa.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: کیفیت تابلوها و راهنمای مسیر در مسیر دوچرخه‌سواری چگونه بر سفر شما اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#Not at all — I can navigate easily rega: اصلاً — حتی با تابلوهای نامناسب هم به‌راحتی مسیرم را پیدا می‌کنم
fa.#Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm: تا حد متوسط — برای مطمئن شدن از مسیر به تابلوها تکیه می‌کنم
fa.#Significantly — unclear or missing sign: زیاد — تابلوهای نامشخص یا نبود تابلو گاهی سفرم را مختل می‌کند
fa.#Very significantly — poor signage makes: خیلی زیاد — بدون GPS یا برنامه تلفن همراه، تابلوهای نامناسب جهت‌یابی را دشوار می‌کند

hu.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: Hogyan befolyásolja a kerékpáros útvonalán lévő táblák és útbaigazítások minősége az utazását?
hu.#Not at all — I can navigate easily rega: Egyáltalán nem — a jelzések minőségétől függetlenül könnyen tájékozódom
hu.#Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm: Közepesen — a táblákat használom az útvonal ellenőrzésére
hu.#Significantly — unclear or missing sign: Jelentősen — a nem egyértelmű vagy hiányzó jelzések néha megzavarják az utamat
hu.#Very significantly — poor signage makes: Nagyon jelentősen — rossz jelzések mellett GPS vagy telefonos alkalmazás nélkül nehéz tájékozódni

ar.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: كيف تؤثر جودة اللافتات وإرشادات الطريق على مسار الدراجة في رحلتك؟
ar.#Not at all — I can navigate easily rega: لا تؤثر إطلاقًا — أستطيع معرفة طريقي بسهولة مهما كانت جودة اللافتات
ar.#Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm: تؤثر بدرجة متوسطة — أعتمد على اللافتات للتأكد من الطريق
ar.#Significantly — unclear or missing sign: تؤثر كثيرًا — اللافتات غير الواضحة أو المفقودة تربك رحلتي أحيانًا
ar.#Very significantly — poor signage makes: تؤثر كثيرًا جدًا — ضعف اللافتات يجعل معرفة الطريق صعبة من دون GPS أو تطبيق هاتف
